_doc: The Monero swap's mainnet policy in one place (MT-B16, BL-27). The companion's defaults are generated from this file (go generate ./xmrswap writes profile_gen.go), profile_test.go fails if the two ever differ, and it checks the t1 rule at every confirmation tier. The app's copy of these values, when it has one (today it quotes none), is to be checked against this file too. Heights and widths are DERO blocks of 18 s; confirmations are Monero blocks of 120 s. A value named in pending waits on the operator decision given there: answering it is a one-line edit here, then go generate. w1min, w2min and g2 are htlc.bas v3's install arguments (MT-A03(a), MT-J13): what tools/simdeploy is run with (-htlc-w1min, -htlc-w2min, -htlc-g2); the maker builds no Lock narrower than max(t1_min, w1min + 11) and the taker refuses an install whose g2 is below this one.

pending.gate_deadline: pending operator decision MT-J04 (decision 5): the operator answered 30; 100 is kept, as recommended, until the answer is confirmed
pending.confirmations_floor: pending operator decision MT-J03 (decision 4): 20 with tiers upward is recommended; allowing 10, disclosed, only after BL-30
pending.confirmation_tiers: pending operator decision MT-J03: the notional thresholds of the 30 and 40 tiers wait on the operator and on BL-30; while they are null every trade is at the lowest tier
pending.t1_max: pending operator decision MT-J05 (decision 6): the operator answered 'lower toward the default t1 plus slack'; 1,200 is kept until the value is set
pending.t2_max: pending operator decision MT-J05 (decision 6): 1,200 is kept
pending.t2_minus_t1: pending operator decision MT-J05 (decision 6): (a) 400, as today; (b) up to 1,200
pending.g2: pending operator decision MT-J13 (G2): the contracts engineer proposed 4,800 blocks (24 h; docs/HTLC_V3_COMPANION_NOTES.md §7); the operator has not answered. It is the Punish window [t2, t2 + g2) and the taker's floor on it; below 11 + 8 + claim_margin + 1 no Punish can go out and be stable in time
